topic: Discussing ClickHouse builds and memory management
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the availability of new ClickHouse (CH) builds following an update. It was noted that newer versions are available in production, with the current stable version being 24.7.6.8.

Concerns were raised about potential inconsistencies introduced by a new query analyzer, suggesting that applying updated builds is advisable. The conversation also covered resource management issues, specifically Out-of-Memory (OOM) kills and memory consumption when using replication and advanced join/grouping features. It was discussed whether allowing swap space or implementing self-recovery mechanisms for CH might be beneficial, but it was recalled that standard recommendations advise against enabling swap.
decisions: The team may apply new ClickHouse builds by the weekend to address potential inconsistencies from the query analyzer.
